intro: Nicaragua has the two largest lakes in Central America and a chain of volcanoes.

chapters.title: Lakes and volcanoes
text: Lake Nicaragua is the largest lake in Central America and has freshwater sharks. Ometepe island is made of two volcanoes. Masaya volcano has a glowing lava lake.

chapters.title: Two coasts
text: The Caribbean coast is wet and forested, with the Corn Islands offshore.

keyTerms.meaning: A pool of molten rock in a crater.
